create_ars_config_defaults: create an ARSConfig instance using all default configuration values for the agent
customize_ars_step_size: customize the ARSConfig step_size parameter to control the optimization step magnitude
configure_ars_directions: configure the num_directions and top_directions parameters to tune exploration in ARS
set_ars_exploration_noise: set the exploration_noise_std parameter on ARSConfig to adjust noise during evaluation
configure_ars_replay_table: set the replay_table_name on ARSConfig to use a custom Reverb priority table
